title: Taboot e ali sehne sayyeda mein rakha hai
body:
Taboot e ALI sehen e sayyeda me rakha hai
HAIDER ke gham me nauhakuna aaj khuda hai
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Baalo'n me gard chaak garebaa'n hai'n Chashm e Nam,
Lashe pidar pe sani e haider yu'n khadha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Taboot ke sir'haane khadhi roti hain fizza..
Abbas ki madar bhi hui mehwe aza hai
<<DIVIDER>>
3. As'haab e murtaza ke saro'n me bhi khaak hai..
Aasaar qayamat ke sar-e-kufa bapa hai
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Gham se hai Aaj Gumbad e Khizra lahu lahu,
Sad Naala o Shewan ka Ajab Shor Utha hai...
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Turbat ko chhodh aaye Risalat Maa'ab bhi,
Ammama sar se aaj mohammad ke gira hai
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Ekkiswi ka Roz qayamat se kam nahi,
Rooh-e-janab-e-fatema zahra ki sada hai
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Ajr e azeem Hoga ata tumko aye "SHABIH"
Sehwan se sakhi lal ki aati yeh sada hai.
